summary: Attachment uploads (`task attachment create-task`, `workspaces attachments post-entity` and their typed MCP tools) send the local file as multipart/form-data via client.PostMultipart, with a required `--file` / `file_path`. The file is streamed between a precomputed multipart head and tail with an exact Content-Length (never buffered whole), and StatUploadFile opens every file so unreadable files fail before any upload.
reason: ClickUp's attachment endpoints accept only multipart/form-data; the generated commands sent a JSON body and could never upload. Upload writes are not replayed on 5xx or transport errors (an ambiguous upload may already have landed); 429 is still retried.
validated_outcome: httptest asserts method, path, custom_task_ids/team_id query, multipart boundary, part name `attachment`, filename, part Content-Type, exact bytes, exact Content-Length (no chunked encoding) and Authorization; 5xx not retried, 429 retried with the full file resent; unreadable files rejected by StatUploadFile; --dry-run sends nothing. Live uploads through all three paths were checked on a scratch task before the switch to streaming.
